race.comment: KIMBERLEY SECRETS (4) underrated mare who showed good speed on resumption and shot clear before being nailed late with a tough second over 1100m here. Clearly come back in good order and can go one better despite drawing poorly again. COUPLES RETREAT (10) frustrating mare who stalked the good speed and warmed up late to finish third over 1100m at this track. Gets a bit more galloping room here and anywhere near her best could win this. LULL (14) appreciated the improving track when given the gun run to defeat inferior opposition over 1100m at Canterbury. Big jump in grade with no weight today and has the ability to take a hand in the finish. STREET ARTIST (13) plagued by poor gates at his last two starts and today is no different. Blinkers come off and look for him finishing hard. Each way. POLYGLOT (3) fitter now after being anchored with the 60kg last start. Worth noting his best form is over this course and distance.
